32: Training uses 50 epochs for the source-only runs and 20 continuation epochs for the control and transfer runs, with a batch size of 8, a learning rate of 1 x 10-4, weight decay of 1 x 10-4, mixed precision, and the PolyGHMDiceLoss objective. Checkpoint selection uses the source validation split only; no target imagery influences training or model selection. The exposure-matched pooled treatment contains 1,795 CAS tiles, 5,925 Jiuzhai Valley tiles, 2,504 Longxi River tiles, 980 Moxitaidi tiles and 178 Wenchuan tiles, for 11,382 training tiles across five domain slots. WeightedRandomSampler assigns sample weight 1/n_domain, so each domain has 0.20 expected sampling mass and an expected 7,168 image exposures at the common budget of 35,840 exposures. The source-only replay placebo uses five copies of the CAS stream with the same 0.20 mass per slot. All experiments ran on a single NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU with 8 GB of memory, and were executed serially.
65: Table 5 shows that pooling source regions lowers source validation IoU from 0.7356 to 0.6418 while changing target macro IoU from 0.0566 to 0.0921. The paired tile-cluster contrast against the replay placebo is +0.0355 macro IoU with a 95% interval of [-0.0005, +0.0948], and the corresponding MCC change is +0.0851 [+0.0015, +0.2308]. The balanced-IoU interval crosses zero. Because the placebo differs from the single-stream regime by only +0.0004 macro IoU, the multi-stream input format itself contributes little. The supported interpretation is region-dependent change in the tested setting, not a uniformly positive effect of source diversity.

70: The transfer results raise a mechanism question about whether performance on unseen regions continues to improve as source fit increases, or peaks and then declines. We tested this across two architectures and three seeds each, retraining under the identical source-only protocol with checkpoints every 10 epochs and evaluating epochs 20, 30 and 50 on all available Hokkaido, Lombok and Palu target tiles. A run supports the temporal pattern if source validation peaks at epoch 50, target Macro IoU peaks at epoch 20 or 30, and the target then declines by at least 0.005. Table 7 reports the six runs.
